data.narrative:
Cosmic Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by James Emerick and Lewis Jones that has raised $4.5M to date. The broader Robotics & Manufacturing sector includes 9 comparable companies (1 public, 8 private), though peer valuation data remains sparse at the Seed stage within this subsector.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable valuation tool, using the $4.5M raised as a proxy baseline and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression. This yields an implied valuation of $11.3M. Peer-median comparison is not viable; while 10 same-sector peers exist, fewer than 3 occupy the same stage, adjacent stages, or comparable valuation tiers, making direct peer-based triangulation unreliable without risking distortion from cross-stage or heterogeneous tier comparisons.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $9.6M to $12.9M, with a median point of $11.3M. This range reflects step-up methodology alone; the single-method foundation introduces material uncertainty. Key dependencies include the appropriateness of the 2.5x multiplier to Cosmic Robotics' specific risk and growth profile, and the stability of the $4.5M raised as a valuation proxy in the absence of disclosed price data. Additional comparable transactions or clearer stage-specific benchmarks would strengthen conviction in this range.
